publications.title: Edge Intelligence: Empowering Intelligence to the Edge of Network
publications.research_problem: Edge intelligence grew rapidly after 2011 without a unified view of its building blocks and solutions.
publications.approach: Comprehensive survey organised around four components: edge caching, edge training, edge inference and edge offloading.
publications.key_contribution: A taxonomy of edge-intelligence problems, techniques and evaluation for each component, with open directions.
